title: 交易心理 | 比预测行情更重要的事：复盘你自己的单子
subTitle:
大部分人花90%的时间预测行情，花0%的时间复盘自己。方向反了。

每笔单子记三行字：为什么开（依据是什么）、哪里错/对（执行层面）、
下次怎么改（具体动作）。坚持一个月，你会震惊地发现：你亏损的
单子里有大量「同一类错误」在反复出现——比如总是止损后立刻反手、
总是盈利单拿不住。

行情会变，但你的行为模式不会自动变，除非你盯着它改。市场是最
诚实的老师，你的交割单就是成绩单。别只看账户余额，去翻交易记录。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#交易心理 #复盘 #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What's More Important Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own trades. They've got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (what was your rationale?), what went right or wrong (in terms of execution),
and what you'll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you'll be shocked to discover: your losses
The same kinds of mistakes keep showing up in your trades—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never holding on to winning trades.

Market conditions change, but your behavior patterns won't change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don't just look at your account balance—go through your trading records.

translatedData.content:
Breaking: The market cap of USD1, the stablecoin from the Trump family-linked project World Liberty Financial, has shrunk by about $400 million in two weeks.

A few key figures:
1️⃣ Market cap fell from about $4.43 billion to about $4.02 billion, a drop of roughly 9%
2️⃣ Most redemptions took place on Ethereum (about $185 million) and BNB Chain (about $200 million)
3️⃣ Nearly all of that roughly $200 million on BNB Chain came from a single address with no identified owner
4️⃣ Over the same period, USD1 supply on Ethereum fell by 11.45%, while USDC fell by just 2.18% and USDT by just 0.76%
5️⃣ Supply on Solana barely changed, and the price held steady at $0.998–$1.000, with no depeg

My take: This looks more like concentrated redemptions by a small number of large holders than a bank run. The price is stable and reserves appear to check out, suggesting the redemption channels are working—which is a positive for a stablecoin.

But it also highlights an issue: a single address can bring the total supply down by about 4.5%, which suggests USD1's holders are highly concentrated and raises questions about the stability of its scale. On top of that, the issuer is preparing to transition from BitGo to a trust company under World Liberty. There are two things to watch next: Will redemptions continue, and will new minting after the transition replenish the supply?

Do you think this is normal portfolio rebalancing by a large holder, or a sign of declining confidence in the project? Share your thoughts in the comments.

#USD1稳定币两周市值减少超4亿美元 #BNB #ETH

content:
重磅：特朗普家族关联项目 World Liberty Financial 的稳定币 USD1，两周时间市值缩水约 4 亿美元。

几个关键数字：
1️⃣ 市值从约 44.3 亿美元降到约 40.2 亿美元，跌幅约 9%
2️⃣ 赎回主要发生在以太坊（约 1.85 亿美元）和 BNB Chain（约 2 亿美元）
3️⃣ BNB Chain 上这约 2 亿美元，几乎全部来自同一个未标记身份的地址
4️⃣ 同期以太坊上 USD1 供应下降 11.45%，而 USDC 只降 2.18%、USDT 只降 0.76%
5️⃣ Solana 上的供应基本没动，价格一直守在 0.998–1.000 美元，没有脱锚

ETH Client Tracker Proposal | Code Still Awaiting Review | Waiting for Confirmation Near 2410

My stance is cautiously neutral: Ethereum’s development progress is worth tracking, but an unmerged code proposal should not be treated as bullish news for the mainnet, much less used to explain every candlestick. Today I checked the official go-ethereum repository. PR #35970  proposes enabling several types of transaction trackers to receive “8037-style” events, involving files for the command-line EVM tool, JavaScript, and native trackers, among others. The page shows that the request is still Open, review by code owners is still pending, and there is explicitly no deployment record. These are verifiable facts about the development process—not evidence that Ethereum has already been upgraded, nor that transaction fees for ordinary users will immediately fall.

Why is this detail worth traders’ attention? Trackers support the observation, debugging, and analysis of transaction execution. If the proposal is reviewed, tested, and included in an official release in the future, developers and infrastructure providers may then gain access to more consistent event data. But there is a long chain of validation between a code proposal, a node upgrade, ecosystem adoption, and changes in demand. So I’m putting this under “network tooling development,” not “immediate capital inflows.” Today’s Square trending topics lean more toward BTC and stablecoin issues; there is no ETH trending tag directly related to this proposal that merits forcing a connection.

Market reactions should also be recorded separately: at the time of writing, Kraken’s latest ETH/USD trade was around $2,412. The price had ranged from about $2,401 to $2,444 during the day, with an opening price of about $2,408. It is trading around the middle of that range, which does not prove that this PR is driving the price up. On the ETF front, the latest complete trading day in Farside’s table, October 16, showed net outflows of about $69.7 million; data for October 19 is not yet complete, so it cannot be described as net inflows or outflows. If a price recovery lacks confirmation from fund flows and trading volume, I won’t turn “active development” into a reason to chase the price.

If I were trading it myself, I wouldn’t go long or short right now; I’d stay in cash. Only if ETH holds above $2,400, breaks above $2,445 on increased volume, and holds $2,430 on a retest would I consider a spot position using about 3% of my total capital, with no leverage. My first target would be $2,480; I’d take half off there, then watch $2,510 for the rest and move the stop-loss up to breakeven. I’d set the initial stop-loss at $2,395 and close the position if that level breaks—without waiting for the news to defend my trade. If $2,400 gives way first, the plan is off, and I’ll watch to see whether new support appears near $2,360. If the PR is closed, testing is blocked, or ETH quickly falls back below $2,430 after breaking out, that would also invalidate my short-term bullish conditions. Keeping code progress separate from trade execution is a way of respecting uncertainty.

Sources: go-ethereum PR #35970, Kraken ETH/USD, Farside ETH ETF. #ETH

我的态度是谨慎偏中性：以太坊开发进度值得跟踪，但不能把一份尚未合并的代码提案当成主网利好，更不能拿它解释每一根K线。今天查看 go-ethereum 官方仓库，PR #35970 提议让多类交易追踪器接收“8037式”事件，涉及命令行 EVM 工具、JavaScript 及原生追踪器等文件。页面显示该请求仍为 Open，代码所有者评审尚在等待，也明确没有部署记录。这是开发过程中的可核实事实，不是以太坊已经升级，不代表普通用户的交易费立刻降低。

这个细节为何值得交易者关注？追踪器服务于交易执行过程的观察、调试与分析。若今后经过审查、测试并进入正式版本，开发者和基础设施服务商才可能获得更一致的事件数据；但从代码提案到节点升级，再到生态使用与需求变化，中间有很长的验证链条。因此我把它放进“网络工具建设”栏，而不是“眼前资金流入”栏。今天 Square 热榜更偏 BTC 与稳定币议题，并没有与此提案直接对应、值得硬贴的 ETH 热门标签。

Blobs have an independent fee market: the blob base fee adjusts automatically based on the gap between usage and the target, and is also burned.
“Proto-Danksharding” is the first step toward full Danksharding: it establishes the blob transaction format and fee mechanism first, with capacity to be expanded gradually later.

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Position Compounding: Fortune Through Risk, or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
The term “position compounding” has been all the rage lately. The stories are all the same: start with a small amount of capital, use several times leverage to ride a big trend, and roll it over a few times
to multiply your money dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about the part they don’t tell you.

【What Position Compounding Involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized profits, you use them as risk capital for new positions and keep opening trades,
It’s like using the market’s money to add leverage. While the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, those unrealized gains
can go from dozens of percent to zero in just one or two steep bearish candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】The essence of compounding positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If each trade has a 60% win rate, the probability of winning four times in a row
is only 13%. Behind every post you see about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

🧭 Wallets & Security | Address Poisoning
· Definition: Some wallets and block explorers flag suspicious zero-value transfers as potential poisoning attempts or hide them by default.
· Why: Address poisoning doesn’t require stealing your private key or getting you to sign an authorization. It exploits the habit of copying addresses from transaction history and checking only the beginning and end.
· Reminder: Save frequently used recipient addresses in your address book and withdrawal whitelist. When making a transfer, select the address from your address book—don’t copy it from transaction history.

When you're losing money, one thought is especially likely to pop into your head: buy a little more to bring down your average cost.

I've fallen into that trap.

Averaging down only changes your position, not your judgment. The money you're adding is new, but it's still tied to the same old mistake.

The price has fallen, which means the market is discounting your judgment. Adding more money now is like buying more of the same mistake at a discount.

The number for your average cost gets smaller, which feels good. But your judgment hasn't changed, your position is bigger, and the next swing will be even harder to stomach.

The real question isn't, “How do I bring down my average cost?” It's, “Are the reasons I bought this in the first place still valid?”
#BTC #ETH

A few things to keep in mind when interacting with testnets:
1) Testnet tokens are usually obtained from a “faucet” and are only used to pay Gas fees for test transactions.
2) A testnet is an independent network that a public blockchain uses to trial new features. Its rules are similar to those of the mainnet, but its tokens have no real value.
3) When using a testnet, try to use a separate wallet. Don’t use the same wallet that holds large amounts of assets.
ETH on a testnet is only for testing; it’s not the same as $ETH  on the mainnet.

What can account abstraction (ERC-4337) do?
Smart contract wallets let you customize verification rules, such as multisig, social recovery, daily transfer limits, and batch transactions. Ethereum originally had two types of accounts: externally owned accounts (EOAs) controlled by private keys, and contract accounts controlled by code. Only externally owned accounts can initiate transactions.
With a smart contract wallet, losing the private key on one device doesn’t necessarily mean losing all your assets. You can regain control according to rules you set in advance.
With the help of a Paymaster, you can perform Ethereum operations even if your wallet doesn’t contain $ETH , with a third party paying the gas fees. Currently 2426.69.

content:
一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至二零二六年十月十九日，以太坊现报价二千四百一十五美元，过去二十四小时微涨零点零八个百分点。价格在盘中触及二千四百四十六美元的短期高点后回落，目前在二千四百元附近窄幅震荡。从日线级别来看，以太坊自上周触及二千三百三十七美元低点后展开反弹，累计反弹幅度约百分之四点二，但反弹动能正在减弱，上方二千四百五十美元附近存在较强阻力。

从均线系统观察，七小时均线位于二千四百三十美元，二十五小时均线位于二千四百零四美元，九十九小时均线位于二千四百二十美元。短期均线依然维持在长期均线上方，但七日均线已开始走平，价格运行在七日均线下方，短线承压较为明显。值得注意的是，九十九小时均线与当前价格非常接近，说明中长期成本线正在成为重要的参考价位。

二、技术指标深度解读

MACD指标方面，DIFF线位于七点八六，DEA线位于六点一二，柱状图为正值一点七四。MACD虽然维持在零轴上方，但柱状图已连续多个周期收缩，从最高点五点六一降至当前的一点七四，多头动能明显衰减。若柱状图继续缩小，DIFF线可能向下穿越DEA线形成死叉，届时短期调整压力将进一步加大。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为五十五点九八，十二周期RSI为五十七点三九，二十四周期RSI为五十三点九二。各周期RSI均处于五十至六十的中性偏强区间，表明市场尚未进入超卖状态，但也缺乏强劲的上涨动能。RSI从此前的高点七十九点八大幅回落至当前水平，显示短期卖压已经得到一定释放。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于二千四百六十八美元，中轨位于二千四百零八美元，下轨位于二千三百四十八美元。价格运行在中轨上方，但距离上轨仍有较大距离。布林带中轨正在成为短期的重要支撑位，若价格能有效守住中轨，则有望向上轨发起挑战；若跌破中轨，则可能向下轨二千三百四十八美元寻求支撑。

KDJ指标方面，K值为四十八点七八，D值为六十一一点一五，J值为二十四点零四。J值已跌至低位超卖区域，K线向下穿越D线形成死叉，短期看跌信号明确。但J值进入超卖区间后，往往伴随着技术性反弹的出现，投资者可关注KDJ指标是否在低位形成金叉。

三、市场情绪与资金面分析

从资金面来看，以太坊面临的压力不容忽视。美国现货以太坊ETF过去一周净流出约三亿二千万美元，这已经是连续第三周出现资金净流出，三周累计流出接近十亿美元。ETF持续失血表明机构投资者对以太坊的短期信心不足，这对价格构成明显的压制作用。

此外，市场传出某知名业界人士已将其以太坊持仓的百分之八十至九十抛售，转而配置股票市场。大户减持行为进一步增加了市场的供给压力，也对市场情绪造成了一定的负面影响。

不过从基本面来看，以太坊仍有诸多利好因素支撑。摩根大通将其存款代币JPM Coin扩展至以太坊主网，实现了全天候近即时链上转账功能，这标志着传统金融机构对以太坊网络的认可正在加深。同时，企业级买家BitMine已购入一万二千五百三十二枚以太坊作为长期储备，企业配置需求的持续增长为以太坊提供了坚实的需求支撑。

从链上数据来看，质押活动有所降温，验证者退出队列与进入队列趋于平衡，这意味着锁仓动态正在弱化。但整体而言，以太坊的链上活跃度仍维持在较高水平，网络效用持续增强。

综合来看，以太坊短期面临ETF资金外流和大户减持的双重压力，技术面多项指标也发出看跌信号。但中长期来看，机构采用加速和企业配置需求增长仍为市场提供支撑。建议投资者关注二千四百元附近的支撑力度，若有效跌破则可能下探二千三百三十七美元前期低点；若能企稳反弹并突破二千四百五十美元，则有望开启新一轮上涨行情。

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Take Losses to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should be no more than 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 losses in a row, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account only draws down 20%, a few winning trades can get you back on track. By contrast, if you go all-in every time and lose 30%,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You'd need to nearly double it just to break even—mathematically, you're basically done for.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
is no more than 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

I mentioned this just a couple of days ago, and now there’s a new development. BofA announced that it’s moving JPM Coin (which represents bank deposits) onto the Ethereum public blockchain, but this is only a test phase, limited to institutional users. Put simply, Wall Street financial products are starting to test the waters on public blockchains, though the barriers to entry remain high.

Why does this news matter?
This reflects a broader fintech trend: banks want to see whether public blockchains can make traditional financial products more efficient and less costly. But BofA isn’t jumping into crypto-style activities; it’s using JPM Coin to test blockchain-based settlement. This means:
- This isn’t about loosening restrictions on cryptocurrencies; it’s about banks using public blockchains to improve payment systems.
- Compared with the crypto payments tussle between Binance and BNPL earlier this year, BofA is more cautious, starting with settlement between institutions.
- Anyone can take part in the test, but ordinary people still can’t really use it. At its core, this is financial innovation.

Impact on the market
In the short term, moves onto public blockchains by major institutions like this could boost market confidence, since JPM is a bona fide Wall Street giant. But the long-term impact depends on who can make money from public blockchain settlement. If it’s used for high-frequency settlement between institutions, it could help make ETH more useful; if it’s just an occasional test, then it remains a fintech concept.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Taking profits in stages: How to lock in gains while letting profits run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because a stop-loss means cutting fear, while taking profits means cutting greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the staged profit-taking approach I always use.

【Three stages】Stage one: when it reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 risk-reward ratio), sell a third to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and your mindset immediately changes. Stage two: when it reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 risk-reward ratio), sell another third. Stage three: trail the rest with a moving stop. If it drops below the moving average
or the previous low, exit and let your profits run.

【Why this works】Sell everything too soon and you'll kick yourself; hold everything and you often ride the elevator all the way back down, giving your gains back.

title: Крипторынок: что важно отслеживать сейчас
subTitle:
Оценивать рынок только по росту одной монеты опасно. Более надёжная картина складывается из нескольких сигналов: динамики BTC и ETH, ширины движения альткоинов, торгового оборота и реакции цены на ключевые уровни.

Если большинство ликвидных пар снижается, отдельный сильный рост ещё не означает полноценного разворота. Если падение замедляется, число растущих пар постепенно увеличивается, а цена удерживает поддержку при устойчивом объёме, это может говорить о стабилизации. Но подтверждение требует повторных наблюдений — одного зелёного свечного импульса недостаточно.

На что смотреть:
• BTC и ETH — направление рынка и способность удерживать локальные уровни.
• Ширина рынка — сколько пар растёт и сколько продолжает снижаться.
• Объём — подтверждает ли он движение или импульс быстро затухает.
• Волатильность и ликвидность — резкие движения могут сопровождаться ложными пробоями.
• Управление риском — заранее определённый уровень отмены сценария важнее попытки угадать дно.

Вывод: не стоит путать краткосрочный отскок с подтверждённым разворотом. Лучше дождаться нескольких согласованных сигналов и оценивать рынок по свежим данным, а не по эмоциям и громким заголовкам.

Материал носит информационный характер и не является инвестиционной рекомендацией. Проверяйте котировки и риски самостоятельно.

title: Ethereum is finding a smarter way to handle cryptography!
subTitle:
Vitalik Buterin proposed EIP-8288, a new approach that could let users verify complex cryptographic calculations without uploading all the original data to the Ethereum blockchain.

How does it work?
Calculations are performed locally.STARK proofs are generated to prove the results are correct.These proofs are combined and uploaded to Ethereum.

Why does this matter?
It could make Ethereum more efficient, reduce unnecessary data on the blockchain, and support different cryptographic technologies without making the network unnecessarily heavy.

The bigger idea: More verification, less data, and a more scalable Ethereum.

Ethereum’s latest plunge below 2,350 liquidated Maji four times and wiped out plenty of retail traders too. What now? Pick yourself up, review what happened, and keep going!! A lot of people blame their liquidations on bad luck, saying things like “the market was too crazy” or “that wick was brutal.” 
But, frankly, most liquidations aren’t caused by bad luck. They happen because people don’t know how to scale into positions.
I’ve seen so many futures traders follow the same playbook:
The price rises a little, so they rush to exit—then the market takes off without them.
The price drops, so they keep adding to their position—until one final wick liquidates them.
They get the direction right, but a few minor pullbacks shake them out.
Put simply, this style of trading has no rhythm.
People who really know what they’re doing approach it the other way around.
They don’t go all-in from the start. Instead, they get three things straight first:
Protect your capital.
Wait for the right entry to add to your position.
Only use profits to scale up.
A lot of people add at the wrong time, so every addition brings them closer to ruin.
One approach that actually works well is scaling in with a reverse pyramid.
What does that mean?
Start by testing the market with a small position.
Once the signal is confirmed, gradually scale up using the profits you’ve made.
Here’s a simple example.
Say you have 10,000 USDT in your account.
First, use only a small portion of your funds to place a test trade—for example, 500 USDT—with a strict stop-loss.
If the market gives no signal, don’t trade.
Better to miss an opportunity than to enter recklessly.
If you’re right about the direction and your position moves into profit, use some of those profits to make your first addition.
If the market keeps moving and breaks below a key level, use another portion of your remaining profits to scale up again.
Here’s the key point: throughout this whole process, your principal has barely been touched.
Once the market develops a real trend and your unrealized profits even exceed your principal, it’s time to start protecting those gains.
For example, hedge part of your position or lock in profits in stages.
If the market accelerates further, you can ride the final leg.
This is what many people fail to understand: skilled traders don’t make money by going all-in on one trade. They build their edge by continually using profits to increase their advantage.
So the root cause of liquidation isn’t the market.
It’s that many people treat trading like gambling from the very start.
The market is indeed brutal, but it’s also fair.
Those who follow rules make money gradually.
Those who don’t gradually get pushed out.
If you’re still placing trades based on gut feeling, sooner or later the market will teach you a lesson.#ETH

以太这波暴跌破2350爆了麻吉4次，也爆了很多散户，怎么办？摔倒了，爬起来，继续复盘继续干！！很多人把爆仓怪到运气上，说什么行情太妖、插针太狠 
但说句不好听的，绝大多数爆仓不是倒霉，是不会滚仓
我见过太多玩合约的操作都一个套路：
涨一点就赶紧跑，结果后面行情直接飞
一跌就拼命补仓，最后一根针直接清算
方向其实看对了，却被几根小回调洗出去
这种交易方式，说白了就是没有节奏
真正会做的人，思路其实是反过来的
不是一上来就重仓赌命，而是三件事先想清楚：
本金要守住
加仓要等位置
只用盈利去滚
很多人加仓加错地方，所以越加越死
真正好用的其实是倒金字塔滚仓
什么意思？
先用小仓位试探行情。
信号确认了，再用赚到的利润一点点往上滚
举个简单思路
假设账户有1万U
第一步只用一小部分资金试单，比如500U，止损卡死
行情如果不给信号，就不动手
宁愿错过，也别乱开
如果方向对了，浮盈起来之后，再拿部分利润去做第一次加仓
行情继续走、关键位置被跌破，再用剩下的一部分盈利继续滚
注意一个重点：整个过程，本金基本没怎么动
等行情真的走出大趋势，浮盈甚至已经超过本金，这时候反而要开始保护利润
比如对冲一部分仓位，或者分批锁利润
行情如果继续加速，再去吃最后一段
这就是很多人不理解的一点：高手不是靠一把梭哈赚钱的，而是靠不断用利润去扩大优势
所以爆仓这件事，本质不是行情问题
是很多人从一开始就把交易当赌博
市场确实很残酷，但它其实很公平
有规则的人，慢慢赚钱
没规则的人，慢慢出局
如果你还在靠感觉下单，那迟早会被市场教育#ETH

放到今天看格外刺眼：99%的山寨币最终将归零，且这是正常的市场清洗。他把代币类比为软件项目——多数软件项目会因为拿不到用户而失败，这是商业常态，不是悲剧（

translatedData.content:
Japan On-Chain Finance Forum Minutes Hit the Trending List | Discussing Payments and Tokenization Doesn't Mean ETH Has Been Chosen | I'm Waiting for Price Confirmation

My stance is cautious and somewhat neutral: regulatory discussions are worth following, but “holding a meeting to study something” should not be translated into “Japanese institutions are about to buy ETH.” The hashtag #JapanFSAPublishesOnChainFinanceForumMinutes appeared on Binance Square’s trending list. I checked the Japan Financial Services Agency’s official website and confirmed that it has a page for its “On-Chain Finance Forum for the AI Era,” as well as minutes from the first meeting, held on September 30. The minutes discuss asset tokenization, stablecoins and tokenized deposits, and programmable settlement. They also highlight the limitations of public blockchains, transaction fees, the difficulty of recovering funds after mistaken transfers or illicit transactions, and the need for payment infrastructure to be stable and secure. The website lists the meeting materials and minutes, but these are records of a discussion—not a decision to approve any particular public blockchain as an official settlement network.

What is the potential mechanism for ETH? Ethereum and its layer-2 networks are often seen as technical options for programmable finance. If compliant institutions actually choose public blockchains in the future to issue assets, settle transactions, or make payments, that could potentially generate transactions, fees, and ecosystem activity. But the same minutes also explicitly discuss the optimal mix of on-chain and off-chain payments, and note that tokenized deposits can use different technologies and permissioning arrangements. So “Japan is discussing on-chain finance” does not necessarily mean “the business will run on Ethereum,” much less that it will generate spot ETH buying today. What really needs to be tracked is the follow-up roadmap, which specific network any pilot uses, the scale of participating institutions, and verifiable transaction volume—not just the number of news headlines.

The market reaction is also a reminder to give the narrative less weight. As I write, Kraken ETH/USD is around $2,415, with an intraday high near $2,444 and a low near $2,401; the price has already retreated from its high. This does not prove that the minutes caused the decline—it simply shows that there has been no sustained one-way rally. Farside’s daily spot ETH ETF table still shows October 16 as the latest complete trading day, with a combined net outflow of $69.7 million. There are no complete end-of-day figures for today’s flows yet, so old data cannot be used to conclude that “institutions are buying after the policy news.” If the price subsequently gets back above $2,444 and holds there, while flows strengthen on the next trading day, the narrative and buying pressure may begin to corroborate each other. If it falls below $2,400 and fails to recover, my short-term bullish assumption is invalidated.

If I were trading this myself: I would stay out for now and only consider a small spot long. I would wait for a 30-minute candle to close decisively above $2,444, then enter a test position only if a retest near $2,440 holds, using no more than 5% of my total capital. The first target is $2,480; I would take half off there and move up my protective stop. The second target is $2,510, where I would close the remaining position in stages. I would set the initial stop below $2,405 and keep the risk on the trade to around 0.2% of my account or less. If the breakout quickly fails, the price falls back below $2,400, or an official roadmap shows that the chosen architecture has nothing to do with ETH, I would abandon this ETH-benefit trade thesis and close the position. If there is no entry trigger, I would remain flat rather than frame a policy discussion as already-realized profit.

#JapanFSAPublishesOnChainFinanceForumMinutes #ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
日本链上金融论坛纪要登热榜｜讨论支付与代币化，不等于选定ETH｜我只等价格确认

我的态度是谨慎偏中性：监管讨论值得看，但不能把“开会研究”翻译成“日本机构马上买ETH”。币安广场热榜出现#JapanFSAPublishesOnChainFinanceForumMinutes；我核对了日本金融厅官网，确有“面向AI时代的链上金融论坛”页面及9月30日第一场会议纪要。纪要谈到资产代币化、稳定币与代币化存款、可编程结算，也同时强调公共链的处理容量、手续费、误转或不正当交易后的追回难题，以及支付基础设施的稳定与安全。官网列出会议材料和纪要，但这是一场讨论的记录，不是批准某个公链为官方结算网络的决定。

对ETH的潜在机制是什么？以太坊及其二层网络常被视为可编程金融的技术选项；若未来合规机构真的选择公链发行资产、结算或支付，才可能带来交易、手续费和生态活动。但同一份纪要也明确提到链上与链下支付的最佳组合，代币化存款可以采用不同技术与许可安排。因此“日本讨论链上金融”并不必然等于“业务落在以太坊”，更不等于今日产生ETH现货买盘。真正需要跟踪的是后续路线图、具体试点采用哪条网络、参与机构规模和可验证交易量，而不是只数新闻标题。

市场反应也提醒我降低叙事权重。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2415美元，日内高约2444、低约2401，价格已从高点回落；这不是证明纪要导致下跌，只说明并未出现持续单边上冲。Farside的现货ETH ETF日表最新完整交易日仍是10月16日，合计净流出6970万美元；今天的资金流尚无完整日终数字，不能用旧数据推导出“政策消息后机构正在买入”。若随后价格重新站上2444美元并守住、且下个交易日资金转强，叙事与买盘才更可能互相印证；若跌破2400美元并迟迟收不回，我的短线偏强假设就作废。

如果是我自己交易：目前不参与，方向只考虑现货轻仓多。等30分钟收盘有效站上2444美元，回踩2440附近没有失守才用总资金不超过5%试单；第一目标2480美元，触及减仓一半并上移保护位；第二目标2510美元，余仓分批平仓。初始止损设在2405美元下方，单笔账户风险控制在约0.2%以内。若突破迅速失败、重新跌到2400美元下方，或正式路线图显示采用与ETH无关的架构，就取消这条基于ETH受益的交易逻辑并平仓。没有入场触发时继续空仓，不把政策讨论写成已兑现利润。

以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

🐋 Beyond watching the charts, this is something you should know too: address poisoning
Some token contracts allow transfers of 0 tokens. Attackers exploit this to create a record that appears to show tokens being transferred from your address, making it look as though you made the transfer yourself.
Address poisoning doesn’t require access to your private key or your signing an authorization. It relies entirely on the habit of copying addresses from transaction history and checking only the beginning and end.
Wallets that frequently transfer stablecoins and $ETH  are more likely to be targeted by address poisoning.
Every potential gain comes with corresponding risks. Think carefully about how much you could lose in the worst-case scenario.

#ETH

content:
🐋 看盘之外，这个知识也得懂：地址投毒
有的代币合约允许转账金额为 0，攻击者利用这一点能制造出一条“从你的地址转出”的记录，看上去像你自己转过账。
地址投毒不需要拿到私钥，也不需要你签授权，靠的全是从记录里复制地址、只核对首尾的习惯。
经常转账稳定币和 $ETH 的钱包，更容易被地址投毒盯上。
每一种收益背后都伴随着相应的风险，多想想最坏能亏多少。

#ETH

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place a Stop-Loss? Here’s How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Too close, and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can wreck you.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might end up right in a cluster of other traders’ stop-losses.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the market structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if the price breaks through this level, it’s evidence that I was wrong.

Big news: By a one-vote margin, the French Parliament has closed the tax loophole of “swapping coins into U to hide for a bit” 🇫🇷

On October 16, the French National Assembly passed an amendment to the crypto tax rules in the 2027 budget bill, with 38 votes in favor, 37 against, and 25 abstentions.

The core change can be summed up in one sentence: starting January 1, 2027, exchanging crypto assets for e-money stablecoins like USDC and EURC under the MiCA framework will be treated directly as a sale.

🔹 Before: Swapping coins into U could defer taxes, and you only settled the bill when you converted back to euros. If the market was bad, you could move into stablecoins first to avoid risk, and you did not have to pay tax right away
🔹 After: The moment you swap into U, any profit is taxable, at a flat rate of 31.4%
🔹 What gets taxed is the gain, not the total amount exchanged

But don’t jump to conclusions yet: this has only passed its first reading, the full budget still needs to be voted on, and the Senate also has to approve it. There are still several hurdles before it officially takes effect.

My take: For many people, stablecoins are basically a “parking lot,” and this move is aimed squarely at that use case. If other countries follow suit, the cost of “swapping into U and waiting” during bull-bear transitions will rise significantly.

content:
重磅：法国议会一票之差，把「币换 U 先躲一躲」的避税路子堵上了🇫🇷

10 月 16 日，法国国民议会以 38 票赞成、37 票反对、25 票弃权，通过了 2027 年预算案里的一项加密税修正案。

核心变化就一句话：从 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，把加密资产换成 USDC、EURC 这类 MiCA 框架下的电子货币稳定币，直接算一次卖出。

🔹 以前：币换 U 可以递延，拖到换回欧元那天才算账，行情不好先进稳定币避险，当下不用交税
🔹 以后：换 U 那一刻有盈利就要交，按 31.4% 的统一税率计
🔹 计税的是赚的部分，不是兑换总额

不过先别急着下结论：目前只是一读通过，整份预算还要表决，参议院也得过，离正式落地还有好几道关。

我的看法：稳定币在很多人手里就是「停车场」，这一刀砍的正是这个用法。如果其他国家跟进，牛熊切换时「先换 U 观望」的成本会明显变高。

Ethereum Market Deep Dive: Institutional Tailwinds Struggle to Offset Bearish Pressure, Rebound Sustainability in Doubt

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of October 19, 2026, Beijing time, Ethereum spot was trading at $2,418.68, up 0.8% over the past 24 hours. On the hourly chart, ETH also surged before pulling back. The price opened at $2,430.79 and reached an intraday high of $2,446.27, but then fell steadily to $2,420.35. The latest hourly candle recorded a volume of just 565 ETH, worth approximately $1.37 million. Volume has contracted sharply, suggesting that buyers have lacked follow-through funding after the price surge.

Looking at the moving averages, the 7-hour average stands at $2,430.28, the 25-hour average at $2,403.59, and the 99-hour average at $2,419.65. The current price has fallen below the 7-hour and 99-hour averages and is only slightly above the 25-hour average, indicating that short-term moving-average support is breaking down. The Bollinger Band upper, middle, and lower bands are at $2,467.13, $2,405.05, and $2,342.96, respectively. The price is currently trading near the middle band; a break below it would put the lower band’s support to the test.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

For the MACD, the MACD line rose from 7.53 to 8.06 before beginning to retreat, while the signal line continued climbing from 1.46 to 5.69. The MACD histogram narrowed from 6.07 to 2.37. Although the MACD line remains above the signal line, the histogram’s continued contraction indicates that bullish momentum is fading rapidly. If it continues to narrow and turns negative, that would form a bearish signal.

The RSI indicates a clear weakening trend. The 6-period RSI fell sharply from 74.77 to 44.88, breaking below the 50 midpoint and entering bearish territory. The 12-period RSI is 53.40, while the 24-period RSI is 52.02. Although both remain in neutral territory, the steep decline in the short-period RSI points to considerable near-term selling pressure. Notably, the RSI-6 previously reached as high as 79.80, in overbought territory, so the current pullback is part of an overbought correction.

The KDJ indicator is flashing a strong bearish signal. The K value has fallen to 46.81, the D value is 66.16, and the J value is just 8.11. The K line has crossed sharply below the D line, while the J value is nearing an extreme oversold level. Such an extreme divergence in KDJ typically occurs during a rapid decline. Although a technical oversold rebound is possible, investors should avoid blindly buying the dip until the K line turns upward again.

The Williams %R (WR) deteriorated from -12.03 to -34.28, retreating from deeply overbought territory to a neutral-to-weak range. The ATR stands at 15.57, with volatility lower than before, suggesting the market has entered a relatively calm consolidation phase.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

The greatest current pressure on the Ethereum market comes from continued institutional outflows. Spot Ethereum ETFs have recorded net outflows for three consecutive weeks, with cumulative outflows reaching $320 million and approaching the $1 billion mark. This coincides with outflows from Bitcoin ETFs, reflecting declining risk appetite among institutional investors toward crypto assets overall.

Whale activity is also a cause for concern. On-chain data shows that some large holders have recently reduced their positions. The validator exit queue and entry queue are nearing balance, indicating that net growth in staked ETH is slowing and pressure from circulating supply is increasing.

However, Ethereum has achieved an important breakthrough in institutional applications. JPMorgan announced that it would bring its deposit token, JPM Coin, to the Ethereum network, providing institutional clients with round-the-clock, instant settlement services. This move further cements Ethereum’s role in institutional-grade settlement infrastructure. Earlier, DTCC also opened tokenization services covering approximately $30 trillion in assets, and BlackRock’s tokenized fund has been used as on-chain collateral. These developments provide solid fundamental support for Ethereum’s long-term value.

There is also positive news on corporate buying. BitMine recently added 12,532 ETH to its holdings. Combined with spot inflows that briefly exceeded $27 million per hour, this drove a rapid rebound from the intraday low near $2,338. However, trading volume contracted quickly after the rebound, indicating significant disagreement in the market at current prices.

Overall, Ethereum faces the dual near-term pressures of ETF outflows and weakening technical indicators. However, the continued rollout of institutional applications and support from corporate buyers provide a foundation for the medium to long term. Investors are advised to watch the $2,343 lower Bollinger Band support and resistance above $2,467, and to remain cautious until the market direction becomes clearer.

content:
以太坊市场深度解析：机构利好难挡空头压力，反弹持续性存疑

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间2026年10月19日，以太坊现货价格报2418.68美元，过去24小时上涨0.8%。从小时级别K线来看，ETH同样经历了冲高回落的走势。价格从2430.79美元开盘，盘中最高触及2446.27美元，但随后连续下跌至2420.35美元。最新一根小时K线成交量仅为565个ETH，成交额约137万美元，量能极度萎缩，说明多头在冲高后缺乏后续资金支持。

从均线系统来看，7小时均线报2430.28美元，25小时均线报2403.59美元，99小时均线报2419.65美元。当前价格已跌破7小时均线和99小时均线，仅略高于25小时均线，短期均线支撑正在瓦解。布林带上轨位于2467.13美元，中轨位于2405.05美元，下轨位于2342.96美元。价格目前运行在中轨附近，若跌破中轨将考验下轨支撑。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标方面，MACD线从7.53上升至8.06后开始回落，信号线从1.46持续上升至5.69，MACD柱状图从6.07缩小至2.37。虽然MACD线仍在信号线上方，但柱状图的持续缩小表明多头动能正在快速衰减。若柱状图继续收窄并转负，将形成看跌信号。

RSI指标显示明显的走弱趋势。6周期RSI从74.77大幅下滑至44.88，已跌破50中轴进入空头区域。12周期RSI为53.40，24周期RSI为52.02，虽然仍在中性区域，但短周期RSI的急速下行意味着短期抛压较重。值得注意的是，此前RSI-6曾高达79.80，处于超买区域，当前的回落属于超买修复过程。

KDJ指标呈现强烈的空头信号。K值降至46.81，D值为66.16，J值仅为8.11。K线大幅下穿D线，J值已接近超卖极值区域。这种极端的KDJ分离通常出现在快速下跌过程中，虽然存在超跌反弹的技术需求，但在K线重新拐头向上之前，不宜盲目抄底。

威廉指标WR从负12.03恶化至负34.28，从深度超买区域回落至中性偏弱区域。ATR指标报15.57，波动率较此前有所降低，市场进入相对平静的调整阶段。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临的最大压力来自机构资金的持续流出。现货以太坊ETF已连续三周录得资金净流出，累计流出规模达到3.2亿美元，距离10亿美元大关越来越近。这一数据与比特币ETF的流出形成共振，反映出机构投资者对加密资产整体的风险偏好正在下降。

大户动向同样不容乐观。链上数据显示，部分大型持有者近期出现减持行为，验证者退出队列与新增队列趋于平衡，意味着质押锁仓的净增长正在放缓，流通供应压力有所增加。

不过，以太坊在机构应用层面迎来了重要突破。摩根大通宣布将旗下存款代币JPM Coin引入以太坊网络，面向机构客户提供全天候即时结算服务。这一举措标志着以太坊在机构级结算基础设施中的地位进一步巩固。此前，DTCC也开放了覆盖约30万亿美元资产的代币化服务，贝莱克的代币化基金已被用作链上抵押品。这些进展为以太坊的长期价值提供了坚实的基本面支撑。

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, let’s talk about how to use them as a sentiment thermometer.

【State 1: Funding rates remain strongly positive】This means longs are crowded and everyone is borrowing to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a top, and a sharp drop caused by a “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. This doesn’t mean you should immediately
It doesn’t mean you should short right away. Instead, be extra cautious about going long at this stage and tighten your stop-loss.

【State 2: Funding rates remain negative】Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often occur near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to get out has already left, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in history have started at moments like this.

$ETH: Understanding Liquidity Through ETH’s Recent Move

When ETH shows an hourly direction down while volume stays above its baseline, the pattern invites a closer look at market liquidity. Liquidity is the ease with which a token can be bought or sold without causing a large price swing. Think of it as a bathtub: the water level represents price, while the drain and faucet represent market orders that remove or add tokens. A wide drain (high liquidity) lets water flow out quickly, keeping the level stable, whereas a narrow drain causes the water to recede sharply when the faucet is turned off.

In the current observation, the price is slipping but the trade flow remains strong. This suggests that enough participants are placing limit orders on both sides, acting as a buffer that absorbs the selling pressure. The spread between the best bid and ask may widen temporarily, but the presence of many orders near the current price keeps the move from accelerating.

To reassess this reading, compare the relative volume metric 2.00221 with recent average volumes. If the ratio stays elevated, it confirms that liquidity is actively supporting the market, even in a downtrend. Conversely, a drop in relative volume would hint that the order book is thinning, raising the risk of larger swings.

A practical step is to watch the order book depth and notice how quickly orders refill after a price move. This simple check helps separate a genuine liquidity cushion from a fleeting surge of activity. 🌊

This can get pretty complicated, so I’ll just cover the key points.
Who decides the order of Ethereum blocks? Do validators decide for themselves?
Simply put, in the MEV-Boost process, builders assemble transactions into blocks and submit bids. Relays pass the bids to the validator proposing a block, and the validator chooses the highest bid.
If you run a validator yourself, find out who operates the relays you connect to and what filtering rules they use. Don’t focus only on the bids.
For blocks produced through MEV-Boost, builders must pay their bids to the validator proposing the block using $ETH .
Understanding how it works can help you avoid some pitfalls, but it can’t replace position management.

Major news: Japan’s Financial Services Agency has released the minutes of the “On-chain Finance Forum” held on September 30. This time, both government bonds and central bank deposits were on the table 🇯🇵

The forum was chaired by Katayama, the Minister of State for Financial Services. Representatives from the Ministry of Finance, the Bank of Japan, the Digital Agency, and the Japanese Bankers Association also attended. A few points from the minutes stand out:

🔹 Ministry of Finance: An expert panel on putting government bonds on-chain (tokenization) will launch in October, starting by examining the impact on the government bond market and related issues
🔹 Bank of Japan: It is advancing a DLT sandbox to test using banks’ current account deposits at the BOJ for on-chain settlement. It is also participating in Project Agorá, led by the BIS, with the goal of enabling 24/7 cross-border settlement
🔹 Figures from the FSA: The global stablecoin market is worth about $310 billion, of which 83% are dollar stablecoins
🔹 The FSA’s PIP payment innovation program has supported four use cases, including yen stablecoin remittances and interbank transfers of tokenized deposits
🔹 Timeline: An interim report and a public-private partnership roadmap are due in early 2027

My take is that Japan is pursuing a “bank-led” approach: government bonds, central bank deposits, and tokenized deposits will all move on-chain, with traditional financial institutions building the infrastructure. Dollar stablecoins account for more than 80% of the market, so if the yen is to claim a place on-chain, this step is inevitable sooner or later.

For crypto markets, this isn’t directly bullish for any particular coin in the short term. But as sovereign assets start moving on-chain, it could generate more real-world demand over the long term for RWAs and public settlement blockchains like Ethereum.

Knowledge Notes | Address Poisoning
① Address poisoning is when an attacker generates a similar address with the same beginning and ending as an address you commonly use, then slips it into your transaction history.
② Checking only the beginning and ending of an address won’t protect you from address poisoning, because it doesn’t cost much to generate addresses with matching first and last few characters.
③ Add frequently used recipient addresses to your address book or withdrawal whitelist. When making a transfer, select the address from your address book instead of copying it from your transaction history.

📰 China’s GDP Beats Expectations, Yuan Hits a Four-Year High—Can It Lift BTC?

China’s GDP grew 4.5% year over year in the third quarter, above the market expectation of 4.4%. Quarter-on-quarter growth of 1.2% also beat expectations. The data pushed the yuan to a four-year high, theoretically giving the global economy a boost. But the crypto market’s reaction was muted, with BTC and ETH moving in different directions. Just how much impact will this have on the crypto market?

Why does this news matter?
China’s economic data is a key indicator for gauging the momentum of the global recovery. This upside surprise means:
1. China’s economy is more resilient than previously expected, leaving room for a policy shift toward the end of the year
2. A stronger yuan points to signs of capital flowing back into China and poses a challenge to the dollar system
3. It could provide a positive boost to global commodity currencies, including Bitcoin’s implicit commodity-like attributes

Market impact
In the short term, the stronger yuan may have a limited effect on BTC:
1. The Fed’s rate-hiking cycle is not over, and the dollar still has safe-haven appeal, weighing on commodities
2. Crypto market sentiment is more influenced by U.S. policy, and the direct transmission channel from Chinese data is unclear
3. Historical data shows that economic indicators beating expectations can sometimes trigger profit-taking in the short term

How to approach it
A stronger yuan is more a signal of macroeconomic currency competition; its impact on BTC is mostly indirect:
- If China’s economic data continues to beat expectations, it could advance the yuan’s internationalization
- But in the short term, BTC is more heavily influenced by U.S. CPI and the Fed funds rate
- This thesis would immediately become invalid if the Fed were to suddenly announce a rate cut

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours, and it’s a payment between longs and shorts
that they make to each other. The exchange simply collects and distributes the payments; it doesn’t profit from them.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no expiry date, so how do their prices stay in line with spot prices? That’s what the funding rate is for:
When the contract price is above the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is below the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What Happens Between a Margin Alert and Liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

【Step 1】Initial margin: The funds required to open a position. For example, at 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position size.
【Step 2】The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add more margin.
【Step 3】Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat through the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

Saudi Arabia is a cornerstone of global oil supply. The fact that it no longer feels safe holding major events at home suggests the local security situation is deteriorating. This could be driven by internal divisions, political instability, or outside interference. The specific cause matters less than the fact that this uncertainty can ripple through global markets. Energy prices and geopolitical risks are back in the spotlight, and crypto, as one of the world’s most sensitive asset classes, is often among the first to absorb these signals.

Market impact
In the short term, the situation in Saudi Arabia could strengthen risk aversion and prompt investors to pull funds out of risky assets. BTC and ETH don’t produce oil, but they are global assets and can be affected by the knock-on effects. Imagine investors watching U.S. CPI while also worrying about oil facilities in the Middle East going up in flames—who would dare keep aggressively pushing crypto higher? This means BTC and ETH could face pressure in the near term, especially for those who like to chase rallies. In the medium to long term, though, as long as Saudi Arabia stabilizes, the crypto market will most likely continue on its own path. This turmoil is more like a test of market sentiment. If BTC and ETH hold steady in the $80K–$85K range, it would show that the market is resilient. ETH cryptography proposal draws attention again | EIP-8288 remains a draft | Discussion alone won’t automatically strengthen prices

My stance is to pay attention to long-term design while staying cautious in the short term. Trending topics on Binance Square are currently focused mainly on BTC breaking out, Russian regulation, and the ZEC upgrade. None directly matches this ETH development, so I won’t use unrelated topics to drive traffic. Today, Binance News reported on Vitalik’s discussion of EIP-8288: by aggregating signatures and proofs off-chain, the proposal envisions allowing different cryptographic schemes to avoid each needing a new precompile. The report can point us toward what to watch, but the EIP text itself is what still needs to be checked. It is currently marked as a Draft; it has not been approved through governance, given a scheduled upgrade date, or deployed on mainnet.

The core idea is for transactions to declare their dependencies, then aggregate multiple proofs into a recursive STARK, with the block carrying the aggregated proof. For ETH, the potential significance is that supporting various cryptographic tools in the future—such as quantum-resistant signatures and zero-knowledge proofs—could avoid putting large proofs directly into on-chain data for every scheme. But this still comes with engineering costs: the burden on block headers, node verification, propagation, and overall complexity all need to be assessed. We shouldn’t conflate “a more flexible design in theory” with “lower gas fees today” or “immediate new demand for ETH.”

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,439, with an opening price of about $2,408 and a 24-hour range of approximately $2,326–$2,444. The price has indeed rebounded from its lows, but there is no evidence that this draft alone drove the rebound. The most recent trading day shown by Farside for U.S. spot ETH ETFs is October 16, with net outflows of $69.7 million; today’s end-of-day fund flows are not yet available. Technical discussions and spot-market flows operate on different time scales. I’d rather wait for volume and flows to confirm before discussing a trend.

The key level is the current swing high near $2,444; whether it can break through decisively will determine if the market makes another short-term attempt to move higher. $2,400 is a round-number level to watch; losing it would weaken the rebound structure. $2,326 is the rolling 24-hour low; if that level breaks again, the bullish view should be abandoned entirely. Another invalidation condition would be if the proposal remains a draft for a long time, with no substantive progress on client implementation or security assessments. In that case, it shouldn’t be given too much weight in valuation.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase the rally right now; I’d just watch the spot market. I’d use no more than 4% of my total capital to test a long position: first wait for a one-hour candle to close above $2,450, then wait for a pullback that holds above $2,444 and buy in two tranches. 我的态度是关注长期设计、短线保持克制。币安广场目前的热门话题主要集中在BTC突破、俄罗斯监管与ZEC升级，并没有与ETH这件事直接匹配的上升标签，所以我不借无关话题引流。今天Binance News转述Vitalik对EIP-8288的讨论：通过链下汇总签名与证明，设想让不同密码方案不必各自新增预编译合约。转述可以提示关注方向，真正要核对的仍是EIP原文；它目前标注为Draft，不是已经通过治理、排定升级日期或部署主网。

这项提案的核心，是让交易声明依赖项，再把多个证明汇总为递归STARK，由区块携带聚合证明。对ETH而言，潜在意义在于未来支持抗量子签名、零知识证明等多种密码学工具时，避免每一种方案都把大体积证明直接塞进链上数据。但这仍有工程代价：区块头负担、节点验证、传播和复杂度都要评估。不能把“设想更灵活”偷换成“今天Gas下降”或“ETH立即有新增需求”。

市场已经怎样反应？Kraken ETH/USD写稿约2439美元，日开约2408，过去24小时约2326至2444。价格确实从低位回升，但没有证据表明回升由这份草案单独驱动。Farside所列美国现货ETH ETF最近可见交易日是10月16日，净流出6970万美元；今日基金日终流向尚不可见。技术讨论与现货资金是两种不同时间尺度，我更愿意等成交和资金确认，再谈趋势。

关键位是2444附近的本轮高点，能否有效突破决定短线是否继续试探上方；2400是整数观察位，失守则反弹结构弱化；2326是滚动24小时低点，若再破，偏多判断应彻底撤销。另一个推翻条件是提案长期停留草案、客户端实现与安全评估没有实质进展，那就不能给它过高的估值权重。

At three in the morning, my phone screen lit up

My name is Chen Lei. I’m 28 years old and work as a programmer at an internet company in Shenzhen. Last October, a colleague invited me to join a crypto group, and my life changed completely after that.

At first, I only dared to buy a little Bitcoin to test the waters. BTC was still above $60,000 back then. I invested 20,000 yuan, and when it rose to $80,000, I made several thousand. It felt incredible—more money than I earned in a whole month at work, and in far less time.

I started wanting more.

In March this year, a crypto influencer in the group called “On-Chain War God” said ETH would break through $5,000 and urged everyone to go long. I looked at the screenshots he posted showing his gains: he’d made ten times his money in a month. I was tempted. I transferred all 80,000 yuan from my salary account to the exchange and opened a 50x leveraged long position on Ethereum.

For the first two weeks, I really did make money. When ETH rose from $2,600 to $3,200, my account showed over 40,000 yuan in unrealized profits. I posted a screenshot on my social media with the caption, “Financial freedom is just around the corner.” When my mom saw it, she called and scolded me, saying gambling would ruin me sooner or later. I told her, “Mom, you don’t understand. This is investing.”

In early April, ETH climbed to $4,100. I was sure $5,000 was within reach, so I borrowed another 50,000 yuan to add to my margin and raised my leverage to 100x. At that moment, I thought I was a genius—the next crypto legend.

Then the nightmare began.

On the night of April 13, the U.S. released CPI data that came in hotter than expected, and the market crashed instantly. ETH plunged from $4,100 to $3,500, then fell to $3,000. With 100x leverage, my position couldn’t withstand that kind of volatility. At 2:53 a.m., I received a liquidation notice.

My 80,000 yuan in principal plus the 50,000 I’d borrowed—130,000 yuan in total—was all gone.

I stared at my phone screen, my hands trembling. My account balance showed 0.01 ETH, the tiny remainder returned after my position was liquidated. I wanted to call my parents, but I didn’t dare. I wanted to confront that influencer, but I discovered he’d already disbanded the group.

That night, I sat on the floor of my rented apartment, with Shenzhen’s neon lights shining outside the window. I thought of what my mom had said, and how I’d once confidently promised to earn a million yuan so she could enjoy life. I didn’t make a million. Instead, I ended up buried in debt.

The months that followed were hard. I worked during the day and delivered food at night to pay off my debts. In six months, I paid back the entire 130,000 yuan. During that time, I didn’t touch a single futures contract—not even spot trading.

Then, last week, BTC fell to $83,000. I saw in the news that CZ had publicly voiced support for XRP and SOL. Although the ETH ETF saw outflows of $550 million in a single week, I thought the bottom might already be in.

I used the 10,000 yuan I’d saved over those six months to buy 0.12 ETH. No leverage, no futures contracts—just a straightforward buy-and-hold.

I don’t know if I’ll make money this time. But I do know that night, when my phone screen lit up at three in the morning, taught me the most expensive lesson of my life.

content:
那个凌晨三点，我的手机屏幕亮了

我叫陈磊，今年二十八岁，在深圳一家互联网公司做程序员。去年十月，同事拉我进了一个币圈群，从此我的生活彻底变了。

刚开始我只敢买一点点比特币试试水。那时候BTC还在六万多美元，我投了两万块，涨到八万的时候赚了好几千。那种感觉太爽了，比上班一个月工资来得还快。

我开始不满足了。

今年三月，群里有个叫"链上战神"的大V说ETH要突破五千美元，让大家开多单。我看着他晒出的收益截图，一个月翻了十倍。我心动了。我把工资卡里的八万块全部转进了交易所，开了五十倍杠杆做多以太坊。

前两周确实赚了。ETH从两千六涨到三千二的时候，我账户浮盈四万多。我截图发朋友圈，配文说"财务自由指日可待"。我妈看到后打电话来骂我，说赌博迟早要完。我说妈你不懂，这是投资。

四月初，ETH涨到了四千一。我觉得五千稳了，又借了五万块加保证金，把杠杆提到了一百倍。那一刻我觉得自己就是天才，是下一个币圈神话。

然后噩梦来了。

四月十三号晚上，美国公布CPI数据超预期，市场瞬间崩盘。ETH从四千一直接砸到三千五，又跌到三千。我的仓位在一百倍杠杆下根本扛不住这种波动。凌晨两点五十三分，我收到了清算通知。

八万本金加五万借款，十三万，全部归零。

我盯着手机屏幕，手在发抖。账户余额显示零点零一个ETH，那是强平后退还的零头。我想打电话给爸妈，又不敢。想去找那个大V理论，发现他早就把群解散了。

那天晚上我坐在出租屋的地板上，窗外是深圳的霓虹灯。我想起我妈说的话，想起自己当初信誓旦旦说要赚一百万让她享福。结果一百万没赚到，反而欠了一屁股债。

后来的日子很难。我白天上班，晚上跑外卖还债。半年时间，我把十三万全部还清了。这期间我没碰过一次合约，连现货都没买过。

直到上周，BTC跌到了八万三。我在新闻里看到CZ公开支持XRP和SOL，ETH ETF虽然在一周流出了五亿五千万美元，但我觉得底部可能已经到了。

我用这半年攒的一万块，买了零点一二个ETH。没有杠杆，没有合约，就是老老实实买入持有。

我不知道这次能不能赚。但我知道，那个凌晨三点手机屏幕亮起的夜晚，是我这辈子最贵的一堂课。

translatedData.content:
Breaking: Latvia changes crypto taxes to «you’re taxed only on how much you ultimately withdraw» 🇱🇻

On October 15, Latvia’s parliament passed amendments to the Personal Income Tax Law in its final reading. The new rules are expected to take effect in 2027. Here are a few details that are easy to overlook:

🔹 No tax on rebalancing within the account: swapping one coin for another or moving funds back and forth isn’t taxed separately. Tax is due only when your total withdrawals exceed your total contributions—and then only on the excess
🔹 These investment accounts can only be offered by providers holding an EU MiCA license, effectively handing the tax calculation process over to regulated platforms
🔹 One-time declaration: you can pay 10% based on the market value of your holdings on December 31, 2026, and use the declared value as your cost basis going forward. The declaration period runs from April 1 to May 31, 2027, and the tax must be paid by July 23
🔹 If you use this option and pay on time, the related undeclared income will no longer be subject to late fees or penalties. This does not apply to cases already under criminal proceedings or a tax audit
🔹 The prime minister’s adviser also revealed that residents may be able to pay taxes directly in cryptocurrency as early as 2027. The Ministry of Finance has agreed, and technical integration is underway

One thing to keep in mind: this 10% is calculated on market value, not profit. Those who bought in early at a low cost may benefit; those who bought at a high price and are currently sitting on losses may not. Before deciding whether to declare, make sure you’ve worked out your cost basis.

In the broader EU context, DAC8 requires platforms to report users’ transaction data to tax authorities. Smaller countries may use «simplified rules + a window for declaring previously undeclared income» to attract compliant capital and licensed providers—a model other countries may draw on next.

If your country or region introduced a similar 10% option for declaring previously undeclared income, would you use it?

content:
重磅：拉脱维亚把加密税改成「只看你最后取走多少」🇱🇻

拉脱维亚议会 10 月 15 日终读通过《个人所得税法》修正案，新规则预计 2027 年起执行。几个容易被忽略的细节，我整理了一下：

🔹 账户内调仓不计税：币换币、来回倒仓都不单独算，只有累计取出金额超过累计投入时，超出部分才需要交税
🔹 这类投资账户只能由持有欧盟 MiCA 牌照的服务商提供，相当于把计税环节交给了受监管的平台
🔹 一次性申报：可按 2026 年 12 月 31 日的持仓市值缴纳 10%，申报值作为以后的成本价；申报期是 2027 年 4 月 1 日至 5 月 31 日，税款需在 7 月 23 日前缴清
🔹 走这条通道并按时缴清的，相关未申报收入不再面临滞纳金和处罚；已经进入刑事程序或税务审计的不适用
🔹 总理顾问还透露，最快 2027 年居民可以直接用加密货币缴税，财政部已同意，目前在做技术对接

有一点值得提醒：这 10% 是按市值算的，不是按盈利算的。早年低成本上车的人比较划算，高位买入、目前还浮亏的人未必合适，要不要申报，得先把自己的成本算清楚。

放到欧盟的大背景看，DAC8 要求平台向税务部门报送用户交易数据，小国用「简化规则 + 补申报窗口」来吸引合规资金和牌照，这个思路接下来可能会被更多国家参考。

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What’s the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you’ll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one without thinking and end up suffering heavy losses.

【Cross margin】All the balance in your account is used as margin. The advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you’re less likely to get liquidated;
The downside: in extreme market conditions, your losses could wipe out your entire account. It’s like putting all your eggs in one
The positions support one another.

【Isolated margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won’t spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My recommendation】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you’re not yet able to assess “the worst-case loss from one bad trade

Why is Ethereum’s gas fee split into a base fee and a tip?
EIP-1559 went live with the London upgrade on August 5, 2021, splitting Ethereum transaction fees into two parts: a base fee and a priority fee (tip).
The protocol automatically calculates the base fee based on usage in the previous block. It rises when usage is above the target and falls when usage is below it.
When managing your positions, the most important thing to keep in mind is this: for transactions that aren’t time-sensitive, consider setting a lower priority fee; for urgent transactions, raise it a little—but don’t set it excessively high by default.

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

ETH ETF outflows near $1 billion in October, as pressure from institutional withdrawals emerges

According to Cointelegraph, U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs have recorded net outflows of about $955 million so far in October, while Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs have seen combined outflows of about $549 million. This data directly points to weakening short-term institutional demand for ETH and is currently the market’s clearest negative signal.

ETH ETFs are the main channel through which institutions gain exposure to ETH, and their fund flows are often viewed as a barometer of institutional sentiment. Outflows of nearly $1 billion in October mean institutions have chosen to reduce their ETH exposure in the short term rather than add to it. These withdrawals may stem from concerns about ETH’s underperformance relative to BTC, or from a broader pullback in risk appetite.

In terms of market reaction, the price of $ETH may face further downward pressure. ETF outflows directly reduce buying support in the spot market, and if the trend continues, ETH’s valuation may shift lower. However, cumulative monthly data may be affected by short-term redemptions or product adjustments, so outflows in a single month do not necessarily signal a reversal of the long-term trend.

The key thing to watch is whether fund flows stabilize going forward. If outflows slow or turn into inflows during the remainder of October, that would suggest the current pressure is more of a short-term adjustment. If outflows accelerate, institutional confidence in ETH may weaken further. In addition, simultaneous outflows from BTC ETFs suggest this is not an ETH-specific issue, but rather a contraction in institutional capital across the crypto market.

From a trading perspective, if you are watching $ETH, it is more worthwhile in the short term to monitor ETF flows for signs of stabilization than to make decisions based solely on price fluctuations.

title: Crypto Basics for Beginners: BTC, ETH & Essential Crypto Terms
subTitle:
📚 
🚀 New to cryptocurrency? Start with the fundamentals!
Before exploring the crypto market, it's important to understand how Bitcoin, Ethereum, and blockchain technology work.
🟠 1. Bitcoin (BTC) — Digital Money
Bitcoin is a decentralized cryptocurrency with a maximum supply of 21 million BTC.
• Peer-to-peer transactions
• Limited maximum supply
• Often described as digital gold
• Price can be highly volatile
🔷 2. Ethereum (ETH) — Smart Contract Platform
Ethereum is a blockchain network that supports smart contracts and decentralized applications (dApps).
• ETH pays Ethereum network transaction fees
• Supports DeFi and NFT applications
• Uses a proof-of-stake consensus mechanism
• ETH can be staked to help secure the network
📖 3. Seven Essential Crypto Terms
🔗 Blockchain: A distributed ledger that records transactions.
🔐 Wallet: A tool for managing blockchain accounts and authorizing transactions.
🗝️ Private Key: A cryptographic secret that controls access to assets.
⛽ Gas Fees: Fees paid to execute transactions on networks such as Ethereum.
📜 Smart Contract: Code that executes according to predefined rules on a blockchain.
🪙 Stablecoin: A cryptocurrency designed to maintain a stable value relative to another asset.
🌐 DeFi: Decentralized finance applications built using blockchain technology.
🛡️ 4. Beginner Crypto Safety Tips
✅ Research before buying any cryptocurrency.
✅ Never share your private keys or recovery phrase.
✅ Double-check wallet addresses and transaction networks.
✅ Avoid fake giveaways and guaranteed-profit promises.
✅ Never invest more than you can afford to lose.
💡 Key Takeaway
Bitcoin and Ethereum serve different purposes, but understanding both provides a strong foundation for learning about the wider crypto ecosystem.
Learn first. Research carefully. Make informed decisions.

Just now, the Zcash community put a troubling issue on the table: even with your private key in hand, you may not be able to move your coins.

At the heart of the discussion is ZIP 2003, part of the NU7 network upgrade. The proposal plans to disable v4 transactions starting with NU7 activation. Sprout, the oldest privacy pool, can only send funds using v4—v5 and v6 are not supported. Under the current draft, coins left in Sprout after the upgrade would no longer be accepted for spending by the network, even if their private keys remain intact.

A few verifiable figures and milestones:
🔹 A public dashboard shows that, as of October 17, approximately 22,309 ZEC remain in the Sprout pool
🔹 These coins will not be “burned”; they will still count toward the circulating supply. However, the team has not promised that spending will definitely be restored in the future
🔹 NU7 is already running on testnet; the mainnet activation height has not yet been finalized. The coordination timeline lists October 20 as the final decision point, while November 5 remains a tentative target date
🔹 The same upgrade will also reduce the target block interval from about 75 seconds to 25 seconds, but the real sticking point is the removal of the old pool’s spending format

To be clear: this does not mean “all ZEC will be frozen.” Transparent addresses and assets in pools such as Sapling that can use the new format are not subject to the same restriction. The risk mainly affects old balances that have not yet been moved out of Sprout, as well as wallets and toolchains that still construct v4 transactions.

The mainnet decision window arrives tomorrow (October 20). If you still have a very old Zcash wallet, you should first check whether it is still using Sprout rather than guessing about the market.

Do you think the community will stick with the freeze, or leave a way out for the old pool?

#Zcash Proposal would freeze Sprout spending under NU7 #BTC #ETH

Technical Principles | Why is Ethereum’s gas fee split into a base fee and a tip?
EIP-1559 went live with the London upgrade on August 5, 2021, splitting Ethereum transaction fees into two parts: a base fee and a priority fee (tip).
The base fee is burned instead of being paid to the block producer, preventing them from stuffing blocks with useless transactions to drive up fees and make money.
Under EIP-1559, the base fee paid for each Ethereum transaction is $ETH , and it is burned directly. Currently 2438.11.
Size your position according to your risk tolerance, and leave yourself some room.

subTitle:

ভূমিকা
Starknet নিয়ে ক্রিপ্টো দুনিয়ায় একটা মজার দ্বন্দ্ব চলছে। প্রযুক্তি ও নতুন ফিচারে এটি দারুণ এগোচ্ছে, কিন্তু STRK টোকেনের দাম ঐতিহাসিক তলানির কাছাকাছি। কমিউনিটির একটি অংশের মতে, এত কিছু হলেও STRK এমনভাবে মূল্যায়িত হচ্ছে যেন কিছুই ঘটেনি। তাহলে সুযোগ, নাকি ফাঁদ? চলুন বুঝে নিই।  (coinmarketcap)
Starknet ও STRK কী? 🤔
Starknet হলো Ethereum-এর ওপর চলা একটি ZK-Rollup Layer 2 নেটওয়ার্ক। এটি লেনদেন দ্রুত ও সস্তা করে এবং নিরাপত্তা নেয় Ethereum থেকেই। STRK এর নেটিভ টোকেন, যা ব্যবহার হয় ফি প্রদান, স্টেকিং ও গভর্নেন্সে।
২০২৬ সালে বড় আপডেট 🔥
১. প্রাইভেসি ইঞ্জিন 🔒
২০২৬-এর প্রথমার্ধে Starknet নিজেকে উচ্চ-গতির রোলআপ থেকে প্রাইভেসি-সংরক্ষণকারী এক্সিকিউশন লেয়ারে রূপান্তর করেছে। এখানে প্রতিটি শিল্ডেড ট্রানজ্যাকশনের খরচ নির্দিষ্ট ৪ STRK, ফলে ব্যবহার বাড়লে টোকেনের চাহিদাও বাড়তে পারে।  (nansen)
২. প্রাইভেট USDC 💵
USDC প্রথম বড় স্টেবলকয়েন, যেটি Starknet-এ প্রোটোকল-লেভেল প্রাইভেসি পেয়েছে।  (nansen)
৩. STRK20 ফ্রেমওয়ার্ক: জুলাই ২০২৬-এ Starknet অন-চেইন অ্যাসেটের জন্য STRK20 প্রাইভেসি ফ্রেমওয়ার্ক চালু করেছে।  (invezz)
৪. ফি ও STRK-এর সংযোগ আছে ⛽
v0.14.3 আপগ্রেডে (২২ জুন ২০২৬) STRK-ভিত্তিক ডায়নামিক গ্যাস ফি যুক্ত হয়েছে। এতে নেটওয়ার্ক ফি সরাসরি টোকেনের চাহিদার সঙ্গে জড়িত হয়েছে।  (coinmarketcap)
৫. লিকুইড স্টেকিং 💧
২৯ জুলাই ২০২৬-এ লিকুইড স্টেকিং চালু হয়েছে, যাতে STRK হোল্ডাররা তরলতা বজায় রেখে আয় করতে পারেন।  (coinmarketcap)
৬. কোয়ান্টাম-রেজিস্ট্যান্স রোডম্যাপ: ৩০ জুন ২০২৬-এ StarkWare Starknet-এর কোয়ান্টাম-প্রতিরোধী রোডম্যাপ প্রকাশ করেছে।  (invezz)
৭. সামনে কী? 🗓️
২০২৬-এর চতুর্থ প্রান্তিকে STRK20 প্রাইভেসি ইঞ্জিন ও strkBTC ব্রিজের পূর্ণ চালু এবং বিকেন্দ্রীভূত ভ্যালিডেটর পর্যায়ের পরিকল্পনা আছে। এটি বিটকয়েন-ভিত্তিক DeFi (BTCFi)-তে প্রবেশের চেষ্টা।  (coinmarketcap)
দামের চিত্র 📉
২০ মার্চ ২০২৬-এ STRK সর্বকালের সর্বনিম্ন $০.০৩৫৪ ছুঁয়েছিল। তারপরেও দাম আরও নেমেছে। ২৬ জুলাই ২০২৬-এ দাম ছিল প্রায় $০.০২৪। তথ্যগুলো জুলাইয়ের,

টেকনিক্যাল দুর্বলতা: কমিউনিটির মতে STRK এখনও দীর্ঘ নিম্নমুখী প্রবণতায় আছে।

Geth proposes a new path for flushing the state database | Author says benchmarks are still needed | Watching for confirmation below ETH 2442

My stance is cautiously bullish, but I won’t treat a client experiment as a bullish catalyst already realized on mainnet. Today, PR #35971 appeared in the official go-ethereum repository, proposing a change to how pathdb buffers are flushed. The author says that when large batches of writes pass through Pebble’s write-ahead log (WAL) commit pipeline, block and code imports may be blocked for about 1 to 3 seconds. The proposal would import buffered content as SST files, bypassing this part of the WAL write path. The 1 to 3 seconds refers to a specific scenario described by the contributor; it does not mean that final confirmation of transactions across the entire network has suddenly become 3 seconds slower, much less that the chain is going offline.

More importantly, consider the status: the page says “experimental change; benchmarks needed.” It is still Open, with no review or deployment. We don’t yet know how it will perform across different disks, node loads, and recovery paths, and can’t even say for certain that it will ultimately be merged. If this database-path change is tested, released, and adopted in the future, it may improve write-related jitter during imports on some nodes and reduce operational friction. But there is no direct equation between client optimization and short-term demand for ETH: it does not mean gas fees will immediately fall, throughput will increase, or token supply will change. I’ll treat it as an engineering development to watch, not evidence of buying pressure.

For this round, I first checked Binance Square Trending Topics and Most Searched, Binance News/Research/OTC, then checked the Fed, SEC, ETH ETF flows, Strategy corporate disclosures, Binance security announcements, and official Ethereum Foundation/client sources. There are no rising trending topics directly related to this ETH engineering proposal, so I’m using only #ETH rather than awkwardly piggybacking on BTC or Russian regulatory tags. ETF daily closing data for individual funds and current order-book conditions use different measures; until flows for the new trading day are updated, we shouldn’t infer from an afternoon price rebound that institutions have already recorded net inflows. If the PR later posts benchmark results and review feedback, I’ll assess whether the performance gains can actually carry over to production nodes.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2430.34, with a daily open of 2407.51 and a rolling 24-hour range of 2326.25–2442.37. The price is above the daily open but has not cleared the top of the rolling range; there’s no evidence to attribute this rise to the newly proposed PR. Around 2442 is the upside confirmation level, around 2400 is the level to watch for a pullback today, and 2326 is the more distant invalidation boundary. If price only briefly spikes above 2442 but fails to hold there, I won’t call it a breakout. If engineering review rejects this implementation path, I’ll also drop the expectation that it might reduce node jitter.

If I were trading this myself: my current position is 0%; I won’t chase the news, and would only consider a spot long. I’d need a 1-hour close above $2443, followed by a pullback that holds within the 2435–2443 range, before entering with no more than 3% of my total capital. I’d first target 2470 and sell half, then target 2500 and continue trimming. If, after entry, a 1-hour candle closes back below 2435, I’d close the remaining position; my hard stop is below 2400, with slippage risk acknowledged. If price breaks below 2400 first, I’ll cancel the long setup; if 2326 gives way, my cautiously bullish view is invalidated outright. If no trigger occurs, I’ll stay flat. I won’t present a plan as an executed trade or a profit, and I won’t use high leverage.

Sources: Official go-ethereum PR #35971 and code diff; Kraken ETH/USD. #ETH
This is solely my personal market commentary and does not constitute investment advice.

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How 100U can control 1,000U—and what it costs
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are just starting out ask me: does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage is when the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U of your own and use 10x leverage, you actually control
a 1,000U position. If the coin price rises 1%, your principal gains 10% (relative to your principal); conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—keep in mind, the loss is calculated based on the total position you borrowed to open.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the coin price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not that
you only lose it all after a 10% drop; a drop of about 10% is enough to wipe you out (the exact threshold also depends on the margin ratio).

Essential Guide: DEX Aggregators
In 1inch’s Fusion mode, users sign a swap order, which is filled by a party called a resolver through competitive bidding. Users don’t pay Gas directly.
Quotes from aggregators are estimates; the actual execution price is also affected by slippage settings and changes in on-chain conditions.
Before authorizing a token, make sure the contract you’re authorizing is an official routing contract published by the aggregator.
When swapping through an aggregator on Ethereum, pay Gas with $ETH ; $1INCH is 1inch’s governance token. Currently 2428.66.

I. Analysis of Ethereum Market Trends

As of the morning of October 19, 2026, Ethereum was trading at $2,438, up approximately 0.9% over the past 24 hours. The price rebounded from a low of $2,338 to above $2,430, showing signs of a technical relief rally after being oversold. Looking at the candlestick chart, Ethereum traded in a narrow range of $2,425 to $2,445 over the past five hours. Trading volume increased noticeably in the seventh interval, reaching around $29 million.

The moving average system shows the 7-day moving average at $2,428.86, the 25-day moving average at $2,402.17, and the 99-day moving average at $2,417.85. The current price is above all three moving averages, with the short-term averages in a bullish alignment. The exponential moving averages (EMAs) also indicate a positive outlook: the 7-day EMA is at $2,425.45, and the 25-day EMA is at $2,410.53. The price is holding above the moving average system.

The Bollinger Bands show the upper band at $2,458, the middle band at $2,398, and the lower band at $2,339. The current price is in the upper portion of the range between the middle and upper bands, close to the upper band, where it faces some short-term resistance.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

For the MACD, the DIF line is at 7.96, the DEA line is at 2.76, and the histogram is at 5.20. The MACD remains bullish above the zero line, with the DIF line consistently above the DEA line. However, the histogram has gradually narrowed from 7.31 to 5.20, indicating that bullish momentum is beginning to wane at the margin.

For the Relative Strength Index (RSI), the 6-period RSI is at 69.46, the 12-period RSI at 61.76, and the 24-period RSI at 55.05. The RSI has retreated from the elevated territory above 74. The 6-period RSI is nearing the 70 threshold, so some short-term overbought pressure remains.

For the stochastic KDJ indicator, the K value is 76.72, the D value is 81.89, and the J value is 66.38. The K line has crossed below the D line, forming a death cross, while the J value has quickly fallen from 84.22 to 66.38, signaling a clear short-term correction. The Stochastic RSI is at 98.01, in extremely overbought territory, so the risk of a short-term pullback warrants attention.

The Williams %R indicator is at -13.78, also in overbought territory. The Parabolic SAR is at $2,380.61, well below the current price, maintaining a medium-term bullish signal. The Average True Range (ATR) is $15.21, indicating low volatility and relatively calm market conditions.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

On the news front, the biggest pressure facing Ethereum is continued outflows from ETFs. U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs have seen net outflows for three consecutive weeks, totaling approximately $320 million, suggesting that institutional investors have become somewhat less confident in ETH in the short term.

More notably, Tron founder Justin Sun publicly stated that he had sold 80% to 90% of his ETH holdings at prices between $3,600 and $4,000, and shifted the funds into U.S. technology stocks, including Nvidia and the Nasdaq 100 index. Meanwhile, the Ethereum staking exit queue has grown close to the size of new deposits, a rare occurrence since the end of 2025, suggesting that some stakers may be converting ETH into spot-market sell orders.

However, Ethereum continues to have positive fundamental factors in its favor. In addition, corporate buying at the institutional level continues: companies recently added 12,532 ETH to their holdings, providing buying support at lower prices.

Overall, Ethereum faces three sources of short-term pressure: ETF outflows, large-holder selling, and staking exits. Multiple technical indicators point to overbought conditions that may need to correct. Investors are advised to watch resistance near $2,458 and support near $2,339, and to trade cautiously.

一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至二零二六年十月十九日早间，以太坊报价二千四百三十八美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之零点九。价格从二千三百三十八美元的低点反弹至二千四百三十美元上方，展现出技术性超跌反弹的特征。从K线形态来看，过去五个小时以太坊维持在二千四百二十五至二千四百四十五美元的窄幅区间内震荡，成交量在第七时段出现明显放大，达到二千九百万美元级别。

从均线系统观察，七日均线报二千四百二十八点八六美元，二十五日均线报二千四百零二点一七美元，九十九日均线报二千四百一十七点八五美元。当前价格运行在三条均线上方，短期均线呈多头排列。指数移动平均线同样显示积极信号，七日EMA报二千四百二十五点四五美元，二十五日EMA报二千四百一十点五三美元，价格站稳均线系统之上。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于二千四百五十八美元，中轨位于二千三百九十八美元，下轨位于二千三百三十九美元。当前价格运行在中轨与上轨之间偏上方位置，接近布林带上轨，短期面临一定的阻力。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标方面，DIF线报七点九六，DEA线报二点七六，柱状线为五点二零。MACD在零轴上方维持多头格局，DIF线持续位于DEA线上方，但柱状线从七点三一开始逐步缩小至五点二零，显示多头动能正在边际衰减。

RSI相对强弱指标方面，六周期RSI报六十九点四六，十二周期RSI报六十一 点七六，二十四周期RSI报五十五点零五。RSI从此前七十四以上的偏高区域有所回落，六周期RSI接近七十关口，短期仍有一定的超买压力。

KDJ随机指标方面，K值报七十六点七二，D值报八十一 点八九，J值报六十六点三八。K线已下穿D线形成死叉，J值从八十四点二二快速回落至六十六点三八，短线调整信号较为明确。随机RSI指标报九十八点零一，处于极度超买区域，需警惕短期回调风险。

Williams %R指标报负十三点七八，同样处于超买区域。抛物线SAR指标报二千三百八十点六一美元，远低于当前价格，维持中期多头信号。ATR平均真实波幅报十五点二一美元，波动性较低，市场处于相对平静的状态。

三、市场情绪分析

从消息面来看，以太坊面临的最大压力来自ETF资金持续外流。美国现货以太坊ETF连续三周出现净流出，累计流出规模约三亿二千万美元，机构投资者短期内对ETH的信心有所动摇。

更为引人注目的是，波场创始人孙宇晨公开表示已在三千六百至四千美元价位抛售了百分之八十至九十的ETH持仓，并将资金转向美国科技股，包括英伟达和纳斯达克一百指数。这一消息对市场情绪产生了明显的负面影响。与此同时，以太坊质押退出队列的规模已接近新增存款规模，这是自二零二五年底以来的罕见现象，暗示部分质押者可能将ETH转为现货抛售。

不过，从基本面来看，以太坊仍有积极因素支撑。 Vitalik Buterin持续推动EIP-8288提案，倡导利用STARK证明进行链下验证，为以太坊的可扩展性升级描绘了清晰的技术路线图。此外，机构层面的企业买盘仍在持续，近期企业增持了一万二千五百三十二枚ETH，在低位提供了买盘支撑。

综合来看，以太坊短期面临ETF外流、大户减持和质押退出的三重压力，技术面多项指标显示超买状态需要修正。但超跌反弹动能和技术面支撑位仍为价格提供了一定的底部保护。建议投资者关注二千四百五十八美元附近的阻力和二千三百三十九美元附近的支撑，谨慎操作。

热门代币方面，AMP报价零点零零零八七九美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之二十二点七七；KORUB报价十二点三零美元，涨幅百分之十六点九二；SNXXB报价九点八零美元，涨幅百分之十二点二六。

title: 交易干货 | 满仓一把梭的数学期望，看完你还敢吗
subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Tips | The Math Behind Going All In—Will You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, with a 50% gain when you win and a 50% loss when you lose. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all in each time, here’s the long-term expected return: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = +10% expected per trade,
which looks like a positive expected return. But consider the path: two losses in a row mean a 75% drawdown, and you’d need a 300% gain just to break even.
A positive-expectation strategy + going all in = a high probability of going bust. This is the gambler’s ruin theorem
playing out every day in crypto.

With the same strategy, but using only 20% of your capital each time: two losses in a row = -18%, barely a dent,
while still capturing the long-term expected returns. The strategy hasn’t changed—only the position size has, and that makes all the difference between survival and ruin.
